Chapter 3 — Control

PanelsDCC Control is the operator interface for your layout: driving trains, operating accessories, and using panels. Complete getting started through §1.4 Driving your first train and §1.5 Your PanelsDCC account if you have not verified a local run and sign-in path yet.

Trains

Operation is built around clear speed, direction, and function feedback. With an account, your configured locomotives and function maps sync from the cloud; without login you can still select by DCC address for testing.

Use the train list or panel overlays to drive; status at the top of the screen reflects connection state to Connect.

Accessories

Points, signals, and other accessories appear with live state where your layout and configuration define them. Route and macro behaviour depends on Configuration.

Panels

Graphical panels mirror your track and signalling. Operate routes and overlays from a single view where you have configured panels.

More detail

For PWA installation, login behaviour, connection status, and quick test by DCC number, see Getting started — Driving your first train and expand your workflow using the rest of this chapter as reference.

For layout design, see Chapter 2 — Configuration. For profile, sync, Wi‑Fi, and updates, see Chapter 4 — System admin.
